wssl.location.v: 14.6 km north of the city centre

wssl.runway.v: one runway, 03/21, 1,836 m long and 46 m wide

wssl.curfew.v: no flights between 22:00 and 07:00 Singapore time (14:00–23:00 UTC), except medical evacuation and emergency flights

wssl.bac.v: non-scheduled flights clear customs and immigration at the Seletar Business Aviation Centre

wssl.handler.v: every arriving and departing aircraft must appoint a licensed ground handling agent

wssl.maxstand.v: the largest stands take aircraft up to a Boeing 757-200 without winglets

wssl.noise.v: subsonic jets need a noise certificate to ICAO Annex 16, Volume I, Chapter 3 or equivalent

wssl.fuel.v: 07:30–22:00 Monday to Friday and 08:30–17:30 on weekends and public holidays, Singapore time

wssl.amdt.v: the 2026 amendments published so far list no change for Seletar beyond its charts

cab.art7.v: each contracting State may refuse aircraft of other States permission to take on passengers, mail or cargo for payment in its territory and carry them to another point within its territory

cab.art5.v: aircraft not on scheduled international services may fly into or non-stop across another contracting State and make stops for non-traffic purposes, subject to the Convention and to the right of the State flown over to require a landing

cab.us.v: a foreign civil aircraft may take on passengers or cargo for compensation at one place in the United States for another place in the United States only if specifically authorised under 49 U.S.C. § 40109(g), or under regulations for foreign aircraft leased or chartered without crew to US air carriers

cab.eu.v: Community air carriers shall be entitled to operate intra-Community air services

cab.icao.ref.v: Article 7 of the Chicago Convention of 1944

cab.most.v: most countries prohibit cabotage for hire, and some also bar carrying non-paying passengers between two of their own airports

cab.seize.v: in Europe and Canada, aircraft can be seized when a cabotage violation is found
